response.rationale: All 7 cited items are positive and none are negative, and they include high-tier sources: Dunlosky 2013 rates distributed practice high utility, and Rawson 2013 found successive relearning raised course exam scores. The Anki studies (Gilbert 2023, Seibert-Hanson 2020) add correlational support for achievement, though Gilbert's detailed Anki statistics correlated little with scores, and the Dunlosky items are duplicated, so the evidence is somewhat less independent than the count of 7 suggests.
